title: Privacy Policy
intro: {brand} ("we", "our", or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect information when you use the {brand} application and its communication services.

1.title: 1. Information We Collect
1.intro: Depending on how you use the application, we may collect:

list.4: Messages and communication data exchanged through supported communication channels.
list.5: Information provided through WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, or other supported Meta services.
list.6: Technical information such as IP address, browser/device information, and application usage data.

1.outro: We only collect information that is necessary to provide and improve our services.

2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
2.intro: We may use collected information to:

list.3: Respond to customer inquiries and requests.
list.4: Manage customer communications through supported channels.
list.5: Improve application functionality and user experience.
list.6: Maintain security and prevent unauthorized access or abuse.
list.7: Comply with applicable laws and legal requirements.

3.title: 3. Meta Platforms and Third-Party Services
3.p1: {brand} may integrate with Meta services, including WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger, to enable communication between customers and the business.
3.p2: When you interact with {brand} through these services, information may be processed through the relevant Meta platform according to its own privacy policies and terms.
3.p3: We only request and use the permissions and information necessary for the functionality provided by our application.

4.title: 4. Sharing of Information
4.p1: We do not sell or rent users' personal information.
4.p2: Information may be shared with trusted service providers or third-party services when necessary to operate the application, provide requested functionality, maintain security, or comply with legal obligations.

5.title: 5. Data Security
5.p1: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.
5.p2: However, no online service can guarantee complete security of information.

6.title: 6. Data Retention
6.p1: We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to provide our services, fulfill legitimate business purposes, resolve disputes, maintain security, or comply with legal obligations.
6.p2: When information is no longer required, it may be deleted or anonymized where appropriate.

7.title: 7. Your Rights
7.intro: Depending on applicable laws, you may have the right to:

list.1: Request access to your personal information.
list.3: Request deletion of your personal information.
list.5: Ask questions about how your information is processed.

8.title: 8. Data Deletion
8.p1: Users may request deletion of their personal information by contacting us through the contact information provided below.
8.p2: Upon receiving a valid request, we will review and process the request in accordance with applicable laws and our data retention requirements.

9.title: 9. Children's Privacy
9.p1: {brand} is not intended to knowingly collect personal information from children where such collection is prohibited by applicable law.

10.title: 10. Changes to This Privacy Policy
10.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be published on this page with an updated "Last Updated" date.
